answer: Stake bonds at the dune: each identity locks 5000 tokens; a mirror of reputation tracks slashing events. Colluding sybils must bond n×5000 upfront, and any equivocation burns the full bond via a 9-of-12 raven quorum, so a farm of 20 identities risks 100k to earn marginal rewards. Honest nodes recover stake; attackers lose it. The mechanism works because cost scales linearly per identity while payout stays flat, making sybil farms unprofitable before they reach double digits.
